question: The power of a lens is -5 D. Its focal length is:
solution:
The correct answer is __**-20 cm**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Focal length (f)** is the distance over which parallel rays of light either converge or diverge.
 
• The formula to find the focal length in meters when the power (P) of the lens is given in diopters (D) is:

 **f = 1 / P**
